metadata.title: Understanding Adults’ Spatial Cognitive Processes: A Time-Embedded N-Grams Model with Machine Learning

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values for cognitive achievement scores as the dependent variables are based on correctness and proficiency level categories.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study explicitly states that it does not report applying PIAAC complex survey weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual adults without accounting for school clustering, indicating a flat model approach.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as 10-fold cross-validation and train/test splits, which do not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.
